messages:
sofia: Quick check — trying to onboard mosaic-lite into staging. Config lint fails with pad_id mismatch and validator complaining weight path is a symlink. Anyone seen this flow? :eyes:
cheng: I saw something similar on rdw-weights earlier. Where is the weights URI pointing to?
sofia: It's `gs://redwood-models/mosaic-lite/v1/weights -> gs://rdw-storage/mosaic-lite/v1/weights/2026-02-10/sha256:abc123` (the ci job resolves symlinks). The validator flagged: `config.json: tokenizer.pad_id(0) != model.pad_token_id(1)`
mike: ah, tokenizer vs model field mismatch. Which config field are we using for serving? pad_id or pad_token_id?
sofia: Our schema expects `tokenizer.pad_id` and `model.pad_token_id` both present, but we have only one set. The linter treats missing fields as null causing the check to fail.
cheng: We should default `tokenizer.pad_id` from `model.pad_token_id` during ingest if missing. There's a one-line fix in the gatekeeper adapter. I'll open a quick PR.
tara: Is the symlinked weights path problematic for the prefetcher? On dedicated infra symlinks sometimes break the checksum step.
mike: The prefetcher dereferences symlinks but the asset-verifier compares the declared size against the resolved object. If symlink points to object with different metadata it flags it. We had a workaround to require canonicalized gcs path in manifest.
sofia: Ok, two action items: (1) cheng to merge an adapter that fills missing tokenizer.pad_id from model.pad_token_id if present; (2) mike to confirm the asset-verifier tolerates symlinked URIs or we canonicalize at ingest. I'll re-run the smoke linter after.
onboard-bot: asset-check: weights-gs://rdw-storage/mosaic-lite/v1/weights/2026-02-10/sha256:abc123 - OK. tokenizer-schema: FAIL - missing `tokenizer.vocab_size` (hint: include vocab.json or set `tokenizer.vocab_size` in config)
cheng: I'll add the fallback + update the schema to allow inference of `vocab_size` when vocab.json exists. PR in a few minutes.
sofia: Awesome. If we can't fix before EOW I'll re-run with a temporary manifest override. Thanks all :thumbsup:
